routeRules.title: Turn rules
routeRules.hint: A rule puts one member first for the turns it matches. It is decided when a turn begins and held for that turn, so tool results return to the model that asked for them. The first matching rule wins.
routeRules.empty: No rules: every turn follows the load strategy.
routeRules.classifierHint: A small model labels each new turn with one of your intents, once, before routing. If it fails or is slow, no intent matches. Its calls are counted as Kun's own usage.
routeRules.overflow: Move near-full requests to a larger window
routeRules.overflowHint: A member whose known window this request fills to 95% goes behind members with more room.
routeRules.nestedHint: Uses every member of {{route}}, in that route's own order.
